column1: # Package root of this repository (cx/spec.md CX-U-7). A `#pragma unisa use NAME` that has no file
# beside the using unit resolves here: the longest PREFIX equal to NAME's leading segments maps NAME
# to DIR/<rest, '.' as '/'>.cx. Rows: R<TAB>PREFIX<TAB>DIR (DIR relative to this file).
# 兼容映射(仅供 apps/csih 28 文件及历史过渡; 到期条件: csih 迁至 textx.* 后即删; 核心 cx/ 不得使用)
